note: Reference hours, written by the factory from common delivery practice and not yet measured. Hours are for a competent engineer at the TYPICAL size, including unit tests, review fixes and handover. The status an estimate shows is computed from evidence (docs/estimate-consistency.md, section 13): no person signs this file off.

calibration.note: ASSUMED thresholds, placeholders until real data exists; change them with a version bump.

tuning.note: Self-tuning limits (docs/estimate-consistency.md, section 14): a value within band of what was measured is fitted and left alone; otherwise it moves step of the way (on a ratio scale), at most cap per version, and never outside floor..ceiling x this file's value. Starting values; change them with a version bump.

kinds.title: Resource API: create, read, update, delete one entity with validation and storage

scale.large: 13-25 fields, or 3+ relations, or custom queries

kinds.title: One endpoint or query: a read, search or report's data

scale.very-large: a heavy reporting query with exports

kinds.title: Business rules, a workflow or a state machine
Sign-in, sessions, roles and permissions

scale.typical: one method with reset or one-time code, 2-3 roles

kinds.title: A third-party service: payments, SMS, email, maps, an identity provider

scale.very-large: several flows plus compliance (card data, health data)

kinds.title: Data model, migrations and seed data

scale.very-large: over 15 entities, or migrating existing data

kinds.title: A background job, schedule or notification sender

scale.very-large: a queue with retries, batching and tracking

kinds.title: Files: upload, storage, or generating PDF, CSV or exports

scale.typical: one generated document or upload with checks
scale.large: several document types or image processing
scale.very-large: bulk import with mapping and error reports

kinds.title: A list or table screen with search, filters and paging

scale.large: 4+ filters, bulk actions or inline edit
scale.very-large: a data grid with grouping, saved views and export

kinds.title: A form screen with validation and submit

scale.large: 13-25 fields, conditional sections or several steps
scale.very-large: over 25 fields, or a multi-step wizard with drafts

kinds.title: A detail, profile or dashboard view

scale.large: tabs, several widgets or live figures
scale.very-large: a dashboard of 6+ widgets with filters

kinds.title: An interactive screen: map, chat, calendar, board, editor or charts

scale.very-large: several linked widgets with real-time collaboration

kinds.title: The app shell: navigation, layout, theme, sign-in wiring, error pages

scale.small: one layout, up to 4 menu items
scale.typical: one layout, roles in the menu, light theme
scale.large: several layouts, two languages or both colour modes
scale.very-large: several apps or right-to-left plus the above

kinds.title: A client-side capability: push, camera, payment sheet, deep links, offline

scale.typical: one capability with permissions and errors
scale.large: two capabilities, or offline sync of one entity

kinds.title: Test plan and cases for a feature

scale.small: one flow, happy path and errors

kinds.title: Automated end-to-end tests for a flow

scale.typical: one flow with its error paths

kinds.title: Client acceptance testing or a regression pass
Designing a screen

scale.small: a variant of an existing screen
scale.typical: a new screen with its states
scale.very-large: a complex screen on several platforms

kinds.title: Client design review and approval: walkthrough of the approved design, the feedback rounds, sign-off

scale.typical: a walkthrough and two feedback rounds

kinds.title: Design system: tokens, components, guidelines
Graphic assets: icons, illustrations, brand pieces
Environments, CI/CD and hosting

scale.typical: dev and production with a pipeline
scale.large: three environments with infrastructure as code

kinds.title: Release: production launch or store submission
Project management, solely agentic: client liaison only (client calls, scope decisions, sign-offs); the factory plans and coordinates its own work
Product documentation: user guide, handover notes
